scope: Broader primary-source research into official SAT/SAB readers and an independent DXF 3D carrier comparator. Sources were reviewed read-only; no app or SDK was installed or executed, no drawing fixture was added, and no support claim or external J status changed.

cadAssistant.commercialImportExportRestriction: Commercial format imports can be inspected but not exported or converted by the app.

independence.parserPath: Separate ACIS import component from libdxfrw; exact reader component identity/build remains to be observed.
independence.kernelLineage: Open CASCADE Technology (OCCT), also used by FreeCAD; does not satisfy a two-kernel gate.
independence.automation: Official product page documents a GUI property query, not a batch API or machine-readable conversion interface.

limits: The official page lists version 1.6.0 from 2021, not a current release assurance.
Download availability, actual ARM64 execution, loaded ACIS component, supported inner ACIS revision, units and diagnostics were not checked.
Area/volume/centroid query does not alone prove B-rep topology validity or complete body inventory.

occtAcisSdk.documentedTranslation: ACIS geometry/topology to OCCT shapes, with optional XDE names and colors; healing and approximation configuration may affect output.
occtAcisSdk.independence: Independent ACIS parser route from libdxfrw, but shares OCCT kernel lineage with FreeCAD and CAD Assistant.
limits: No license, evaluation package, binary or execution was available in this review.
No claim is made that every source ACIS revision or entity type translates exactly.
Reader and writer format revisions, healing settings, units and output semantics require separate qualification.

ansys.product: Ansys ACIS Geometry Interface, Release 2026 R1 (v261)
ansys.independence: Separate product/reader candidate; actual parser and geometry-kernel lineage is not stated in the inspected documentation and must not be assumed.
limits: No installation, entitlement or runtime test was performed.
Hidden/suppressed body policy, units, body decomposition and import options must be bound in any receipt.

fields: ASMTransform (12 real values, column-major affine transform)
modernAcisCarrier.geometry: 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY/SURFACE are skipped as OGR geometry; the driver does not translate their ASM carrier to a B-rep.

other3dLimits: 3DFACE is exposed as a polygon, but the driver documents that 3DFACE/SOLID/TRACE lack elevation support and are always 2D.
Curves are tessellated; default INSERT expansion and its 10,000-feature block limit can change counts unless configured.
The driver reads DXF, not DWG.
dxfComparator.plannedUse: Optional structural cross-check of raw modern DXF ASM bytes and transform only; not an ACIS parser, B-rep semantic oracle, or 3DFACE 3D-geometry oracle.

planImpact.macOSArm64: An official CAD Assistant macOS ARM64 SAT/SAB reader is documented and is a plausible match to the user's selected platform route, but it is an old listed release and has not been run. Preflight binary, component, actual SAT/SAB profile and stable per-body property query before counting it as external evidence.
planImpact.independence: CAD Assistant, its ACIS SDK and FreeCAD share OCCT geometry lineage. They can provide distinct parser paths but cannot count as two independent geometry kernels. Ansys is a separate candidate but its lineage is unverified and its platform does not match macOS ARM64.
planImpact.gdal: Use GDAL only at one composed AC1027+ DXF carrier checkpoint; pin build/options, leave blocks unexpanded, compare raw bytes/hash and a calibrated transform, and report unavailable when the exact runtime is absent.
planImpact.implementationSpeed: Keep the immediate implementation slice local: add generated in-memory DataStorage page-chain coverage, run only its existing fast CTest plus LC3 compatibility check, and defer the optional GDAL/native/kernel gates to composed milestones.
planImpact.fixturePolicy: No DWG/DXF/SAT/SAB fixture or external binary was added. Future controls remain scratch or locally authored in-memory data unless eligible pre-existing repository fixtures are used.
